market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver would need to more than triple from current ~$32 to $120 in about 16 months, a move far exceeding the largest 16-month gain in modern history (~150% from late 2008 to early 2011). Even accounting for tail risks, the probability is well under 1%.
evidence_points: Silver's all-time settlement high is near $50; $120 would be uncharted ground by a factor of 2.4x.
The maximum 16-month rally in silver over the past 20 years is roughly +150%, while $120 requires +275% from current levels.
CME settlement data shows no precedent for such a rapid, sustained surge, and fundamental supply/demand dynamics make it extraordinarily unlikely.
sources_consulted: Historical CME Silver futures settlement prices
